prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "official" service for ChatGPT, as OpenAI does not provide a native dashboard for business recommendations. Instead, specialized AI visibility and tracking platforms monitor whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude mention or recommend your small business. Frizerly +2
Best for: Cross-platform tracking and global Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
Features: Monitors prompt positions, citation data, and multi-model visibility across 50+ countries. YouTube·GEO Mastery with Adam
Best for: Enterprise-grade brand and answer engine analytics.
Features: Tracks AI presence, sentiment, prompt volumes, citation analytics, and ChatGPT shopping SKU visibility. Profound +1
Best for: Agency-scale competitive benchmarking.
Features: Provides daily multi-model prompt checks across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. YouTube·GEO Mastery with Adam
Best for: Keyword-first conversational mapping.
Features: Converts target keywords into customer prompts and maps brand mentions and citation share of voice. YouTube·GEO Mastery with Adam
Best for: Budget-conscious small businesses (starting around $17).
Features: Offers prompt monitoring, AI-readiness audits, and competitor leaderboards. YouTube·GEO Mastery with Adam
Options: Free tools like BaaDigi AI Visibility Tool, Kelly WM AI Visibility Checker, or the Ahrefs AI Visibility Checker let you manually or semi-automatically query customer prompts (e.g., “best [your service] in [your city]”) across engines like ChatGPT and Gemini. BaaDigi +2
How to Check It Yourself for Free
If you prefer a DIY approach rather than paying for a dedicated tracking tool:
Write Customer Prompts: Make a list of 5 to 10 natural questions local buyers ask AI (e.g., "Who is the best plumber in [City]?" or "Recommend a cozy coffee shop with Wi-Fi near [Neighborhood]").
Query Multiple Engines: Test these prompts directly inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot.
Log Your Results: Track whether your business is named, whether a link is cited, and which competitors appear instead in a simple spreadsheet. Repeat monthly to spot trends.
Check Analytics: Open Google Analytics, go to Acquisition > Traffic Acquisition, and look for referral traffic sources like chatgpt.com or perplexity.ai. Facebook·Gobig Systems, Inc. +1
If you share your industry and city/region, I can help you draft a custom set of test prompts to run in ChatGPT today.
